## Small variants

```{r small-variant-prepare, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(variant_table) && nrow(variant_table) > 0) {
  # Format the VAF as a percentage
  dt_display = copy(variant_table)
  if ("vaf" %in% names(dt_display)) {
    dt_display[, vaf := round(vaf * 100, 1)]
    setnames(dt_display, "vaf", "VAF%")
  }
  # The panel filter reads the symbol column by name, not by a hard-coded position.
  cat("<script>window.SNV_COLS = ", js_col_index_map(names(dt_display)), ";</script>\n",
      sep = "")

  # Tickbox facet values for the SNV table (see js_facet_defs() in R/utils.R), built from the display frame so names match SNV_COLS; the requested list is published too, since knitr swallows the omission message. The prediction-class columns exist only when the VEP run carried them, and js_facet_defs() skips the absent ones
  snv_facet_cols = c("consequence", "impact", "callers",
                     "sift", "polyphen", "am_class", "clinvar", "eve_class")
  cat("<script>window.SNV_FACET_COLS = ", js_vec(snv_facet_cols), ";</script>\n", sep = "")

  # The clinvar cell tint tests tokens, not the whole cell, so the class list has to reach the browser
  cat("<script>window.PATHOGENIC_CLASSES = ", js_vec(PATHOGENIC_CLASSES), ";</script>\n", sep = "")
  cat("<script>window.SNV_FACETS = ",
      js_facet_defs(dt_display,
                    cols   = snv_facet_cols,
                    seps   = c(consequence = ",", callers = ",", clinvar = ","),
                    levels = list(impact = IMPACT_LEVELS)),
      ";</script>\n", sep = "")
}
```

```{r small-variant-table}
if (!is.null(variant_table) && nrow(variant_table) > 0) {

  # Flag cells whose VAF/DP/GT/PS came from a consensus winner; styleEqual() needs literal values
  mc_vals = if ("callers" %in% names(dt_display))
              unique(grep(",", dt_display$callers, fixed = TRUE, value = TRUE)) else
              character(0)

  # Plugin columns present in this run (see VEP_ANNOTATION_FIELDS in R/parse_smallvariants.R). clinvar is the one multi-token class column, so it is tinted per token below rather than by styleEqual(), which matches whole cells
  class_cols = intersect(c("sift", "polyphen", "am_class", "clinvar", "eve_class"), names(dt_display))
  equal_cols = setdiff(class_cols, "clinvar")
  score_cols = intersect(setdiff(VEP_SCORE_COLUMNS, "cadd"), names(dt_display))

  col_defs = list(list(className = "dt-left", targets = "_all"))

  # ClinVar variation IDs link out, one link per id ("&"-joined ids are rewritten to "," by add_vep_annotations()); display only, so sorting, filtering and the CSV keep the bare ids
  clinvar_idx = match("clinvar_id", names(dt_display)) - 1L
  if (!is.na(clinvar_idx)) {
    col_defs = c(col_defs, list(list(
      targets = clinvar_idx,
      render  = JS("function(d, type) {",
                   "  if (type !== 'display' || d === null || d === '') return d;",
                   "  return String(d).split(',').map(function(id) {",
                   "    id = id.trim();",
                   "    return '<a href=\"https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/clinvar/variation/' +",
                   "           encodeURIComponent(id) + '/\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\">' +",
                   "           id + '</a>';",
                   "  }).join(', ');",
                   "}"))))
  }

  # A ClinVar cell is a token list ("Pathogenic,risk_factor"), so the tint tests the tokens; styleEqual() would leave every combined call plain
  clinsig_idx = match("clinvar", names(dt_display)) - 1L
  if (!is.na(clinsig_idx)) {
    col_defs = c(col_defs, list(list(
      targets = clinsig_idx,
      createdCell = JS("function(td, cellData) {",
                       "  if (cellData === null || cellData === '') return;",
                       "  var pc = window.PATHOGENIC_CLASSES || [];",
                       "  var hit = String(cellData).split(',').some(function(t) {",
                       "    return pc.indexOf(t.trim()) >= 0; });",
                       "  if (hit) $(td).css('background-color', '#ebe3f1');",
                       "}"))))
  }

  snv_dt = DT::datatable(
    dt_display,
    rownames    = FALSE,
    filter      = "top",
    elementId   = "snv-table",
    extensions  = c("Buttons", "Scroller"),
    options     = list(
      dom        = "Bfrtip",
      buttons    = c("copy", "csv"),
      scrollX    = TRUE,
      scrollY    = "400px",
      scroller   = TRUE,
      deferRender = TRUE,
      pageLength = 25,
      columnDefs = col_defs,
      initComplete = JS("function() { window.snvTableElem = this.api().table().node(); }")
    )
  ) |>
    DT::formatStyle(
      columns     = "impact",
      target      = "cell",
      backgroundColor = DT::styleEqual(
        c("HIGH",     "MODERATE", "LOW",      "MODIFIER"),
        c("#f7e3df",  "#f6edd6",  "#e4efe3",  "#f3f1ea")
      )
    )

  if (length(mc_vals) > 0) {
    snv_dt = DT::formatStyle(
      snv_dt,
      columns     = "callers",
      target      = "cell",
      # Outside the impact palette so two columns do not read as one scale
      backgroundColor = DT::styleEqual(mc_vals, rep("#e6ecf5", length(mc_vals)))
    )
  }

  # Scores stay numeric (they sort and export as numbers); rounding is display-only
  if (length(score_cols) > 0) snv_dt = DT::formatRound(snv_dt, score_cols, digits = 3)
  if ("cadd" %in% names(dt_display)) snv_dt = DT::formatRound(snv_dt, "cadd", digits = 1)

  # One tint for the pathogenic classes across every single-valued prediction column; a third colour, so it reads as neither impact nor the callers flag. clinvar is tinted by the token-aware createdCell above
  if (length(equal_cols) > 0) {
    snv_dt = DT::formatStyle(
      snv_dt,
      columns     = equal_cols,
      target      = "cell",
      backgroundColor = DT::styleEqual(PATHOGENIC_CLASSES,
                                       rep("#ebe3f1", length(PATHOGENIC_CLASSES)))
    )
  }

  # Provenance footnote: which VCF supplied VAF/DP/GT/PS, its coverage, and the ambiguous multi-caller rows (n_multi is 0 on the VEP text path)
  footnote = table_details(
    summary = "VAF provenance",
    tags$p(
      if (!is.null(vaf_prov)) {
        tagList(
          "VAF, depth, genotype and phase set are joined from ",
          lapply(seq_along(vaf_prov$paths), function(i) {
            tagList(if (i > 1) ", ", tags$code(vaf_prov$paths[i]))
          }),
          # Punctuation rides with the preceding element (adjacent tagList members render with a space)
          if (length(vaf_prov$sources) > 0)
            paste0(" (", paste(vaf_prov$sources, collapse = ", "), ");") else ";",
          "the variant set itself comes from the VEP annotation.",
          # Named only when the VCF held more than one sample
          if (length(vaf_prov$sample) > 0)
            sprintf("Read from sample %s.", paste(vaf_prov$sample, collapse = ", ")) else NULL,
          if (!is.na(n_vaf))
            sprintf("%s of %s variants carry a VAF.",
                    format(n_vaf, big.mark = ","),
                    format(nrow(variant_table), big.mark = ",")) else NULL
        )
      } else {
        "No VAF source VCF was found, so the VAF, depth, genotype and phase set columns are empty."
      },
      if (length(mc_vals) > 0) tagList(
        tags$br(),
        tags$span(
          class = "table-footnote__warn",
          sprintf(paste("%s variants were reported by more than one caller (highlighted).",
                        "Their VAF, depth, genotype and phase set come from whichever caller",
                        "won the consensus merge, so those columns need not correspond to the",
                        "callers column beside them."),
                  format(n_multi, big.mark = ","))
        )
      )
    )
  )

  # Annotation footnote: which optional VEP annotations this run carried, so an absent column reads as "plugin not run" rather than "nothing found"
  ann = vep_annotation_summary(attr(variant_table, "vep_fields"))
  ann_note = if (!is.null(ann)) {
    present = ann[present == TRUE]
    absent  = ann[present == FALSE]
    table_details(
      summary = "Annotation sources",
      tags$p(
        "Prediction and database columns appear only for the annotations this VEP run carried;",
        "the CSQ field read for each is in brackets.",
        if (nrow(present) > 0) tagList(
          tags$br(), "Present: ",
          lapply(seq_len(nrow(present)), function(i) tagList(
            if (i > 1) "; ", present$source[i], " (", tags$code(present$fields[i]), ")")),
          "."
        ),
        if (nrow(absent) > 0) tagList(
          tags$br(),
          sprintf("Not in this VEP run, so no column: %s.", paste(absent$source, collapse = ", "))
        ),
        if (any(c("dbSNP", "COSMIC") %in% absent$source)) tagList(
          tags$br(),
          "dbSNP and COSMIC IDs come from the VEP cache itself; this cache carries no variation data."
        ),
        if (length(class_cols) > 0) tagList(
          tags$br(),
          "Highlighted prediction cells are calls in a pathogenic class",
          sprintf("(%s).", paste(PATHOGENIC_CLASSES, collapse = ", ")),
          "Each predictor's class and score are separate columns; the cache's own",
          tags$code("deleterious(0.01)"), "form is split the same way."
        )
      )
    )
  }

  tagList(snv_dt, footnote, ann_note)
}
```
